rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent for something that is unlikely to succeed.

example.english: This plan looks unpromising and probably will not succeed.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃冇乜希望成功喇。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gai3 waak6 mou5 mat1 hei1 mong6 sing4 gung1 laa3

rows.note: Use this especially for a person, career, project, or plan whose future prospects are poor.

example.english: He chose this line of work, but I think it is unpromising.
example.traditional: 佢揀咗做呢行，但我覺得呢行冇前途。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gaan2 zo2 zou6 ne1 hong4 daan6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 ne1 hong4 mou5 cin4 tou4

rows.note: Use this when expressing a speaker's negative assessment or prediction about a person's or thing's chances of success.

example.english: I think his chances in this election are unpromising.
example.traditional: 我唔睇好佢今次選舉嘅勝算。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 tai2 hou2 keoi5 gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 ge3 sing3 syun3
